units.text: INT. SEAGULL - CONTINUOUS
Satan, my mighty foe, advances; I see his dread and lurid eyes.
units.name: NINA

units.text: I smell sulphur. Is that done on purpose?
units.name: ARKADINA

units.text: Yes.
units.name: TREPLIEFF

units.text: Oh, I see; that is part of the effect.
units.name: ARKADINA

units.text: Mother!
units.name: TREPLIEFF

units.text: He longs for man--
units.name: NINA

units.text: To DORN.
You have taken off your hat again! Put it on, you will catch cold.
units.name: PAULINA

units.text: The doctor has taken off his hat to Satan father of eternal matter--
units.name: ARKADINA

units.text: Loudly and angrily.
Enough of this! There’s an end to the performance. Down with the curtain!
units.name: TREPLIEFF

units.text: Why, what are you so angry about?
units.name: ARKADINA

units.text: Stamping his foot.
The curtain; down with it!
units.name: TREPLIEFF

units.text: The curtain falls.
Excuse me, I forgot that only a chosen few might write plays or act them. I have infringed the monopoly. I--I---
units.name: TREPLIEFF

units.text: He would like to say more, but waves his hand instead, and goes out to the left.
What is the matter with him?
units.name: ARKADINA

units.text: You should not handle youthful egoism so roughly, sister.
units.name: SORIN

units.text: What did I say to him?
units.name: ARKADINA

units.text: You hurt his feelings.
units.name: SORIN

units.text: But he told me himself that this was all in fun, so I treated his play as if it were a comedy.
units.name: ARKADINA

units.text: Nevertheless---
units.name: SORIN

units.text: Now it appears that he has produced a masterpiece, if you please! I suppose it was not meant to amuse us at all, but that he arranged the performance and fumigated us with sulphur to demonstrate to us how plays should be written, and what is worth acting. I am tired of him. No one could stand his constant thrusts and sallies. He is a wilful, egotistic boy.
units.name: ARKADINA

units.text: He had hoped to give you pleasure.
units.name: SORIN

units.text: Is that so? I notice, though, that he did not choose an ordinary play, but forced his decadent trash on us. I am willing to listen to any raving, so long as it is not meant seriously, but in showing us this, he pretended to be introducing us to a new form of art, and inaugurating a new era. In my opinion, there was nothing new about it, it was simply an exhibition of bad temper.
units.name: ARKADINA

units.text: Everybody must write as he feels, and as best he may.
units.name: TRIGORIN

units.text: Let him write as he feels and can, but let him spare me his nonsense.
units.name: ARKADINA

units.text: Thou art angry, O Jove!
units.name: DORN

units.text: I am a woman, not Jove.
units.name: ARKADINA

units.text: She lights a cigarette.
And I am not angry, I am only sorry to see a young man foolishly wasting his time. I did not mean to hurt him.
units.name: ARKADINA

units.text: No one has any ground for separating life from matter, as the spirit may well consist of the union of material atoms.
units.name: MEDVIEDENKO

units.text: Excitedly, to TRIGORIN.
Some day you should write a play, and put on the stage the life of a schoolmaster. It is a hard, hard life.
units.name: MEDVIEDENKO

units.text: I agree with you, but do not let us talk about plays or atoms now. This is such a lovely evening. Listen to the singing, friends, how sweet it sounds.
units.name: ARKADINA

units.text: Yes, they are singing across the water.
units.name: PAULINA

units.text: A pause.
To TRIGORIN.

Sit down beside me here. Ten or fifteen years ago we had music and singing on this lake almost all night. There are six houses on its shores. All was noise and laughter and romance then, such romance! The young star and idol of them all in those days was this man here,
units.name: ARKADINA

units.text: Nods toward DORN.
Doctor Eugene Dorn. He is fascinating now, but he was irresistible then. But my conscience is beginning to prick me. Why did I hurt my poor boy? I am uneasy about him.
units.name: ARKADINA

units.text: Loudly.
Constantine! Constantine!
units.name: ARKADINA

units.text: Shall I go and find him?
units.name: MASHA
